rules.statement: The issue of summons is contingent upon the document forming the basis of the action not being prescribed.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) A condition precedent to the issue of summons is that the document on which the action is based should not appear to be prescribed ; the plaintiff's action based on the 2 cheques is clearly prescribed. (ii) It if appears to Court that the plaintiff respondent's action is barred by some provision of a statute the defendant petitioner should be allowed to appear and defend without being ordered to furnish security. (iii) In an action under Summary Procedure, a claim for unjust enrichment is not a liquid claim arising upon the two cheques and is not a proper subject for Summary Procedure.
